name: Rei (零 · XR) — the prime coin
tagline: Supply on the primes, split by Riemann's R, lossless money
summary: Rei is the whole coin and XR its tenth decimal (1 Rei = 10^10 XR). Supply starts at 2 Rei and steps up the primes (mint = next prime − this prime) when a Foundation-proposed milestone is accepted by holders, paid into savings; nothing burns and moving XR is free. The first spec (14 Oct) split each step by Riemann's R function ('prime rata'); the 16–17 Oct documents pay steps 'in proportion' and no longer mention R.

ideas.name: Prime staircase
ideas.one_liner: Supply is always a prime number of Rei; each step mints the gap (1, 2, 2, 4, 2, 4…).

ideas.name: Prime rata
ideas.one_liner: New units split by R(balance)/ΣR instead of balance; small holders gain slightly.

name: Rei — the one sale, the Foundation and a public home
tagline: One sale up a ladder, no equity sold, bonds and a merger
summary: The equity co sells XR once, at launch: sell orders from $0.03 to $0.30 over 6.2 billion XR on MIAX's XR/USD book, 30 days from 1 November 2027 (proposed), with 50 XR minted to the Foundation and 19 to the equity co for every 31 sold. Bonds fund the build; after the sale the equity co would reverse-merge into AMBR and buy Gemini for stock. The legal target is a digital-commodity sale under the 17 March 2026 SEC/CFTC interpretation, with Reg A and Reg Crypto Assets as fallbacks.

name: Rei × MIAX — the XR/USD book and one account
tagline: XR spot, crypto perps and AP stock perps at MIAX
summary: MIAX would list XR/USD spot (the one sale's book) and run the US market for bitcoin and ether perps and dated options, margined and settled in dollars 24/7 at its own clearinghouse; every Rei Pay payment sells XR on that book. AP's single-stock perps sit in the same account through the equity co as introducing broker and Dorman as FCM. AP's draft MPPLA pays AP 60% of MIAX's fees on every perpetual on any underlying, so Rei's perps must be carved out before AP signs.

name: XR — the language for organizing
tagline: No where; only settled facts and promises with check times
summary: XR began on 3 October 2026 as 'a language for organizing people, built on mixed reality', whose goal is 'the greatest organization in the world'. It has two sentence types (settled, or promised with a check time), turns opinions into dated bets, and uses zk tick compression so a constant-size proof carries a growing record. On 16 October XR became Rei's ticker and the house style of every Rei document.

ideas.name: Two kinds of sentences
ideas.one_liner: Settled, or promised with a time it can be checked; 'Will you?' is the only question.

ideas.name: Opinions are bets
ideas.one_liner: 'This deal loses money by March' replaces 'I don't like this deal'.

ideas.name: Zk tick compression
ideas.one_liner: Each tick's proof swallows the last; same size, growing information; post-quantum.

ideas.name: Compliance edge
ideas.one_liner: A running proof to regulators that limits hold every second, showing no position.

name: Rei consumer surfaces — map, iMessage, Spaceyard
tagline: One page: agent left, 3D map right, coins for every handle
summary: Rei's app is one page with the agent on the left and a friendly 3D map on the right: avatars, pets in portals, stores that take Rei Pay, and every @handle a coin of a million units. Rei opens inside iMessage through a native app's Messages extension, prototyped as the Nimbus iOS app (15–16 Oct). Spaceyard (19 Oct) is a sibling live-stream map with its own in-app currency, SPY.
